title: Stability-compatible kernels: beyond Gaussianity for impulse response estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kernel-based regularization for linear system identification uses positive semidefinite kernels both to define reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) and as covariance models for stochastic impulse responses. Sharp kernel conditions are known for RKHS stability, while almost-sure BIBO stability under Gaussian priors requires an even more restrictive covariance condition. These restrictions, however, need not persist beyond Gaussianity, where the covariance no longer determines the full probability law. We introduce the notion of a stability-compatible kernel, namely a covariance kernel admitting at least one stochastic realization with almost-surely absolutely summable sample paths. We show that stability-compatibility holds if and only if the stable elements are dense in the associated RKHS, a condition strictly weaker than RKHS stability, and derive practical sufficient conditions, including a spectral criterion for stationary ker

translated_title: 稳定性相容核：超越高斯性的脉冲响应估计
translated_abstract: 线性系统辨识中基于核的正则化方法使用半正定核既来定义再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS），又作为随机脉冲响应的协方差模型。目前已知的核条件可以精确刻画RKHS稳定性，而在高斯先验下的几乎必然BIBO稳定性则需要更为严苛的协方差条件。然而，这些限制在超越高斯性的情形下未必继续成立，因为此时协方差不再决定完整的概率分布规律。我们引入了“稳定性相容核”的概念，即一种协方差核，它允许至少一个具有几乎必然绝对可和样本路径的随机实现。我们证明，稳定性相容性当且仅当稳定元素在相应RKHS中稠密时成立，该条件严格弱于RKHS稳定性，并推导出了实用的充分条件，包括针对平稳核的谱判据。
tldr: 该论文提出“稳定性相容核”的新概念，证明其当且仅当稳定元素在对应RKHS中稠密时成立，从而在超越高斯先验的情形下为脉冲响应估计提供了比已知条件更弱的几乎必然BIBO稳定性判据。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the notion of stability-compatible kernels for impulse response estimation, proving that stability compatibility holds if and only if stable elements are dense in the associated RKHS—a condition strictly weaker than RKHS stability—thereby relaxing almost-sure BIBO stability guarantees beyond Gaussian priors.
